content_html:
watched #Petta : Go get RAJINIfied!!! after all the social message oriented slow paced movies from Pa.Ranjit….Karthik Subbaraj was successful in delivering a much needed commercial pot boiler for the Super Star _/\_

as its a commericial movie so lets not care about logic and story line!!! Karthik was successful in glorifying Rajini’s screen presence and style charisma!!! Anirudhs BGM is asusual terrific and sets the perfect canvas for the superstar to unleash his neverending stylish charisma!!!! Also loved the way director tried to take dig at RSS and BJP in a subtle manner 😛

Though didnt get much meatier roles…..Vijay Sethupathi and Nawazuddin Siddiqui proved icing on the cake with their terrific acting!!! After a long gap was pleasently surprised to see Simran on the big screen and she is beautiful as usual and the romance between Simran and Rajini were dealt in very cute manner!!!!

Rajini’s first dialouge in the movie is “ayipoyanu anukunaru kadharaaaaaaa……..(and there is the Rajinis typical laugh) and looks like it was intentional as though Rajini is facing very low in his career but he is never out of the Race!!!!
